scope: Conservative package boundary ownership; capability lists are review surfaces, not proof of effects or their absence. No VCP runtime adapter is implemented by this inventory.

seams.observation: Native exec starts private in-process protocol work; VCP ownership and admission must precede coding and review submissions.
Unsubscribe and client shutdown are effectful lifecycle operations; normal exit does not prove durable root/child pause or crash reconciliation.
A one-shot review child makes an observed provider request while the pinned parent CLI reports zero usage; VCP must retain independent request and usage receipts.
The Responses-based fallback makes a separate model request and replaces prompt history; upstream local compaction is not local inference or canonical VCP history.
Submission enters the retained session; attach VCP task/workspace and authority revision before scheduling.
Interrupt delegates to session task abort; this is not durable VCP pause or tree-wide admission fencing.
Inter-agent input queues work; mailbox starts now consult host continuation admission before reserving or consuming it. Default hosts still admit; scoped pause and cancellation remain unimplemented.
Main streaming admission, usage attribution and cancellation must enter the VCP gateway.
Prewarm can create provider traffic before normal streaming; do not exempt it from authority/accounting observation.
The API helper is a separate remote path from the main coding stream.
Background memory work constructs a model client and streams a stage-one prompt; replace independent admission.
Compaction requests require the same capability, budget and provenance boundary as coding.
A review thread is still governed child work with root budget, authority and pause lifetime.
Guardian review must not become an unaccounted helper or substitute for user authority.
Retries revalidate current authority and maintain request/usage attribution.
Provider auth resolution includes upstream account/identity paths that must not bypass explicit VCP configuration.
The exported ambient-key helper is not authorized VCP credential discovery.
Even credential-presence telemetry is an upstream effect to remove or explicitly replace.
Policy amendment performs writes; parsing/matching reuse does not authorize saved permission changes.
Global telemetry setup must not create a hidden exporter outside VCP ownership.
Retained realtime APIs do not authorize an extra VCP provider/service route.
MCP startup can launch a local process; use an explicitly configured server identity and execution authority.
Remote MCP transport needs explicit endpoint, redirect, authentication and cancellation policy.
Tool calls and results retain VCP schema/authority/receipt boundaries; tool text cannot create instructions.
Authentication discovery is network activity even before tool invocation.
Dispatch must follow durable VCP admission with prepared arguments, environment and workspace identity.
Termination is separately observed; stopping a child does not roll back already observed effects.
Upstream state initialization must not create a competing authoritative VCP store or memory ledger.
Retain useful storage-neutral interfaces while adapting local persistence to VCP receipts, history and recovery.
Read-only snapshot/candidate evaluation; adapt findings and revisions to VCP canonical evidence.
In-process mutable reference store, with UUID and clock inputs; not durable VCP authority.
Local artifact filesystem I/O; require VCP-authorized roots and durable generation publication.
Tantivy index construction uses scratch files and mappings; account for resources and scope in VCP.
Real DiskANN graph provider and serialization; qualify scope, recall and reopen with actual local embeddings.
Reads only explicitly supplied local asset files, verifies bounded bytes and consumes the verified buffers; missing/corrupt assets remain setup errors.
Bounded CPU BERT inference with explicit masks, truncation reporting and normalized vectors; caller workspace policy and indexing admission remain future integration boundaries.
Release-only startup checks schedule remote version discovery and cache writes; debug exec traces do not exercise this path.
The retained daemon updater fetches installers and restarts processes; VCP does not inherit this independent update authority.
Creates a maintenance lock file and acquires an OS lock; a method named try_acquire is not read-only.
Fire-and-forget maintenance compresses and replaces stored history; VCP must own lifetime, retention and durable publication.
The facade exports live controller/store/provider APIs; re-export syntax does not make its exported surface pure.
Feature configuration also publishes telemetry; data getters and this effectful method have different contracts.
ANSI rendering can log formatted input on unexpected multiline data; VCP must control diagnostic output and retained content.
Replays synthetic claims through scoped volatile governance before real CPU/index construction; not a durable canonical store or networking sandbox.
Replays retained governance, verifies persisted artifacts, filters scoped current claims and compares exact vectors; no durable governance recovery claim.
Qualification executable alone emits controlled same-host TCP canaries; independent parent validates Windows containment, live controls and real CPU inference. File-only library has no network route.

An owned qualification thread reads this process's Windows memory counters and committed address regions. It must finish before a resource result can pass; it is not a product scheduler or memory limit.
Seals the registered subtree under one lock, waits for start permits and owns retained interruption without consuming events.
Requires current instance/revision, attached owner, completed interruption and no inherited hold; independent child holds remain.
Owner loss seals the registered tree, owns retained interruption and native job quiescence, and fences late receipts before journal ownership release.
Owned retained interruption keeps the controller/event stream open; its receipt does not prove durable pause or native descendant quiescence.
Only finalized age ciphertext reaches the vault; signed inner inventory requires separately enrolled writer authority and local lineage before restore.
One private journal atomically admits root/child flat-tariff requests with durable intents; interrupted requests keep liability.
Bounded prepared-file, native verifier and scoped Munarium proposal/recall operations use the same owner and journal.
Clone-based revision and evidence validation cannot execute external work.
Opaque ID generation consumes system randomness; transition predicates remain pure.
Artifact validation and durable state/event/receipt persistence occur under one canonical owner.
Current authentication precedes receipt lookup; owner/revision checks precede new durable commands.
One snapshot computes root/child/daily caps with canonical revision guards.
Send capability follows a durable canonical receipt; retry cannot resend.
Versioned projection and watermark publish atomically without re-executing effects.
Thread binding, exact captured body, checked quote and durable send intent precede each actual retained HTTP request.
Existing contained native jobs offer full stdout/stderr before display truncation and terminate on capture failure.
Canonical reopen retains liabilities, marks interrupted effects unknown and holds tasks before deliberate resume.
Explicit Git executable/environment, native owned jobs, bounded output/deadlines and read-only arguments.
No-follow native handles retain directory ancestry and deny concurrent write/delete while reading.
Injected access-aware artifact resolver validates exact selected ranges before issuing a non-authorizing context proof.
Current captured context, file/instruction dependencies and exact provider body precede shared-root reservation and send intent.
Observed provider costs settle once; absent cost retains liability and served identities remain unknown when absent.
Bounded byte framing and complete schema-checked terminal calls perform no transport or tool execution.

groups.gate: One VCP controller; persist authority revisions, pause the root/child tree, reject stale completions and reconcile before explicit resume.
VCP owns startup configuration, explicit pause/resume and owning-CLI loss; upstream subcommands are not automatically VCP surfaces.
OpenRouter-only coding/model gateway; capability and atomic budget admission for main/helper/retry/prewarm paths; explicit transport and catalog authority.
Disable ambient key/token/account/command discovery. Retained credential primitives require explicit VCP configuration and authority.
Remove/disable upstream telemetry and remote feedback. Any retained local diagnostic output follows VCP redaction, scope and retention policy.
Replace competing canonical writes with the VCP store/receipt contract; preserve complete observed history and protected recovery/accounting references.
Explicit VCP settings and workspace identity; disable cloud/default-provider discovery and deferred foreign-configuration import entry points.
Prepared revision-checked effects, current policy and durable dispatch/receipts; policy-file amendment and migration are writes, not pure matching.
Qualify native Windows job/PTY, child-tree termination and actual access restrictions; do not infer Windows enforcement from Unix code or mocks.
Keep useful private protocol machinery while retaining one owner. Public APIs, independent daemons and upstream provider proxies are not VCP entry points.
Workspace-scoped reads and prepared writes; account for Git subprocesses, watchers, junction/path races and preservation of user edits.
Visible children share root budget/store/authority; fence queued/background work on pause and preserve independently paused children.
Replace upstream memory ownership with governed VCP memory. Stage-one/background summarization calls must use the same admitted model gateway.
Review/helper requests consume admitted budget; model-produced assessment cannot create user authority or bypass VCP permission ceilings.
Skills/MCP use VCP trust, schema, auth, cancellation and budget boundaries. Executable hooks remain deferred despite retained upstream code.
No independent code-execution path may bypass the VCP tool broker; optional upstream runtimes are not implicitly enabled by this import.
Disable non-VCP provider/service routes. Retained tools need explicit VCP capability/policy integration; this does not authorize remote embedding fallback.
Retain representations/templates where compatible. Types and model text carry no authority; public API/schema exports remain deferred.
Retain deterministic formatting/parsing where compatible; display truncation and summaries must not overwrite canonical history or establish authority.
Account for local resource, timer and task lifetimes; no background helper outlives owner pause or retains restricted/deleted context through caches.
Use explicit synthetic fixtures and isolated build/test resources. Test clients, samples and helper binaries are not VCP product entry points.
Local governance and indexes remain behind canonical VCP scope, durability and accounting; reference in-memory state is not a second controller or store.

File-only CPU library with pinned assets and independent vectors. Test executable emits explicit local network canaries for P0-02 observed containment; broader corpus resource qualification remains open.

Retained controller with one canonical storage/accounting worker, private current-authority commands, per-HTTP admission/raw capture and native output observation. Earlier P0 journal is a separate regression fixture; P2/P3 own provider and product CLI policy.
Disposable SQLite/framed-file comparison and age/Ed25519 authenticated snapshot prototype; production storage and restore activation remain P1/P5.
Pure transition and codec functions are separate from UUID randomness; no UI, database or provider dependency.
One OS owner, durable state/event/receipt transactions, local artifact staging and controlled activation. Process fixture is qualification-feature only.
Authenticated private commands and current host capabilities; no second scheduler. Retained transport/accounting integration remains P1 work.
Checked integer quotes, atomic shared-root reservations and durable send intent; no transport in this package.
Pure event folds, atomic projection activation and current-authority history reads. Process fixture is qualification-feature only.
Explicit native root handles and bounded contained Git observations; parent access only through registered instruction roots. Product policy integration remains P2 work.
Pure deterministic selection and sealed manifests; captured-byte verification invokes an injected current-access resolver. Repository types retain their native dependency closure.
Pure bounded OpenRouter conversion, endpoint snapshot validation, framing and normalization. Canonical host owns capture, freshness, admission and retained transport.

classification_scope: Every selected package inherits an explicit conservative module effect ceiling and primary owner; named entries refine that envelope after source review, including delegates/callbacks. These are trust classifications, not formal purity proof, runtime enforcement or an exhaustive per-function call graph.
